title: Linearised gravity and the Newtonian limit
summary: Linearisation about flat spacetime; gauge transformations and gauge invariance of the linearised curvature; the trace-reversed perturbation and the wave equation; the static limit and the Newtonian metric; gauge-invariant degrees of freedom.

objectives.description: Objectives will be finalised when the unit is prepared; the source material is 8.962 Lectures 14–15 (Lecture Guide page 4), Tong Chapter 5 and Carroll Chapter 6.

preparation.description: Read the Lecture Guide's synopses of Lectures 14 and 15 (PDF page 4): linearisation, gauge, trace reversal, the Newtonian limit; radiative Green's function and gauge-invariant degrees of freedom.
Watch Lectures 14 and 15 from the video gallery (transcripts on each lecture page).
Second account: Tong, General Relativity, Chapter 5 When Gravity is Weak (reference-only), the sections on linearised gravity and the Newtonian limit.
Optional: Carroll, Chapter 6 Weak Fields and Gravitational Radiation (first half), reference-only.
